mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,balance,points,membership_expire,update_time FROM user_asset WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_asset(user_id,balance,points,update_time) VALUES(#{userId},0,0,NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE user_asset SET balance=balance+#{amount}, update_time=NOW() WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE user_asset SET balance=balance-#{amount}, update_time=NOW() WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND balance >= #{amount}
UPDATE user_asset SET points=points+#{points}, update_time=NOW() WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE user_asset SET points=points-#{points}, update_time=NOW() WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND points >= #{points}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND used=0 AND expires_at>NOW()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND name='新人券'

SELECT id,user_id,name,discount_amount,min_order_amount,expires_at,used,order_id FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND used=0 AND expires_at>NOW() ORDER BY discount_amount DESC, min_order_amount ASC, expires_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT id,user_id,name,discount_amount,min_order_amount,expires_at,used,order_id FROM user_coupon WHERE id=#{couponId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND used=0 AND expires_at>NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupon(user_id,name,discount_amount,min_order_amount,expires_at,used,create_time) SELECT #{userId},'新人券',5.00,20.00,DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL 30 DAY),0,NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND name='新人券')
mapper.update: UPDATE user_asset SET membership_expire=DATE_ADD(GREATEST(COALESCE(membership_expire,NOW()),NOW()),INTERVAL 30 DAY), update_time=NOW() WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE user_coupon SET used=1, order_id=#{orderId} WHERE id=#{couponId} AND used=0
UPDATE user_coupon SET used=0, order_id=NULL WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND used=1
mapper.select: SELECT id,type,amount,points_delta AS pointsDelta,reason,create_time AS createTime FROM user_asset_ledger WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
